{{Quote|The only chance the malkloc has is the fact that the flit has a damaged wing from its tussle with the dire cat in the previous round.''"<br />"''And the fact that they normally hunt in swarms.|[[Tendau Nandon]] and [[Dusque Mistflier]]|<ref name="ROD" />}}
'''Flits''' were [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] flying [[Reptile/Legends|reptiles]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lok/Legends|Lok]]. They had thick hides and extremely sharp beaks as well as a number of [[Poison/Legends|poisonous]] barbs, making them a dangerous predator. Flits were also found on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell's]] [[Tansarii Point Station/Legends|Tansarii Point Station]] and the [[Prison/Legends|prison]] world [[Despayre]]. On Lok, the [[Reptavian/Legends|reptavians]] were [[Hunting/Legends|hunted]] and used for meat, but they could also be tamed and made into effective fighters. One such tamed flit won the [[Blood/Legends|blood]] sport competition at the [[Aerie Casino opening|opening]] of the [[Aerie Casino]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]].

==Biology and appearance==
Flits were [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]], [[Reptavian/Legends|flying reptiles]] usually growing a wingspan greater than the height of a tall [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]]. They had two smaller [[Limb/Legends|limbs]] with sharp claws for grabbing. Flits had thick hides, very sharp beaks<ref name="ROD" />&mdash;[[Color/Legends|orange]] at the peak but fading in color toward the head&mdash;and a small tuft on the back of their neck. Their plumage was a mix of blue and green shades.<ref name="SWG" /> They also had dorsal barbs tipped with a powerful [[Poison/Legends|poison]]. A small prick from the barbs was capable of felling a grown [[Human/Legends|Human]].<ref name="DS" /> There was some variety within the flit [[Species/Legends|species]], such as flit harassers, flit bloodsuckers, and giant flits. These differed in strength and size.<ref name="SWGP">[[Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref>

Flits attacked in swarms, swooping around their prey,<ref name="ROD" /> alternately advancing and retreating.<ref name="SWG" /> They were particularly effective attacking at night, when it was much harder to avoid them.<ref name="DS" /> Despite their savagery, flits could be tamed.<ref name="SWGP" />

==History==
[[File:Flits.png|thumb|left|180px|Flits interacting in their native environment]]
Flits were indigenous to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lok/Legends|Lok]],<ref name="ROD" /> located in the [[Karthakk sector/Legends|Karthakk sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="SWG" /> There, they were found around the barren land surrounding [[Nym's Stronghold|the stronghold]] of the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Nym/Legends|Nym]] during the early years of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Despite the danger posed by the flits, the locals hunted their meat and used their [[Bone/Legends|bones]].<ref name="SWGnote">In ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', players can receive "Lokian Avian Meat" and "Lokian Avian Bones" upon killing flits.</ref> Elsewhere in the Mid Rim,<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> flits were also found aboard [[Tansarii Point Station/Legends|Tansarii Point Station]], which [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]]<ref name="SWG:ASHT">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|A Small Hunting Trip|Tansarii Point Station}}</ref> of the [[Bright Jewel Oversector/Legends|Bright Jewel Oversector]].<ref name="Geonosis">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref> The [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] hunter [[Wyle Artis]] sought to hire a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to hunt some flits and [[Scyk/Legends|scyks]] for him in the Tansarii Point atrium, offering [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] and a necklace for successfully completing the job.<ref name="SWG:ASHT" />

Flits were also found on [[Despayre]],<ref name="DS" /> located in the [[Atrivis sector/Legends|Atrivis sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="Rebellion">[[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']]</ref> They occasionally infiltrated the perimeter fences of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Prison/Legends|prison]] compounds stationed planetside, causing a threat to the residents there. All the flits on Despayre perished with the [[Destruction of Despayre|destruction]] of the planet by the first [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] that occurred in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].<ref name="DS" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], a trained flit harasser was entered into the [[Blood/Legends|blood]] sport competition that marked the [[Aerie Casino opening|opening]] of the [[Aerie Casino]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. Trained by a [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]], the reptavian eventually won the competition, defeating a [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomiri]] [[malkloc]] in the final round by landing on its back and stabbing its sharp beak deep into the malkloc's neck.<ref name="ROD" />

The [[Laser Flits]], a gang from [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]], [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], was named after the creature.<ref name="SWG:WW">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Wald's Woes|Tatooine}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Flits were created for ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and produced by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG" /> that debuted in [[2003]] and shut down on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> In the game, they were an opponent on Lok, one of the ten original playable worlds,<ref name="SWG" /> as well as part of a quest for beginner players on [[Tansarii Point Station/Legends|Tansarii Point Station]].<ref name="SWG:ASHT" />
